title: Proposal validation time budget (M5-T088 G5 F-HIGH-1): a request-level total-positions bound and an O(n log n)-class simplicity check in the proposed-massing validator, with decision-identical results on every accepted fixture
objective: The M5-T088 security review measured that services/api/app/scenario/proposal.py's hand-rolled all-pairs ring simplicity check (_ring_is_simple) runs once per outline - footprint plus up to 500 per-level outlines of up to 1000 positions - with NO request-level total bound, so a single validator-valid request can take minutes (7.5-22 min measured/extrapolated). The validator runs behind the flag-gated proposal-validation and proposal-checks routes today and ahead of every massing bound. Add (1) a request-level TOTAL-positions bound (footprint + all level outlines) that refuses with a typed ProposedMassingError before any simplicity check, and (2) replace or bound the O(n^2) simplicity check (e.g. shapely validity/simplicity on the already-admitted shapely, or a metered sweep) so worst-case wall time per request is bounded and MEASURED. Every accepted fixture and test must reach the SAME accept/refuse decision and the same refusal field; any semantic difference between the old and new simplicity checks must be found by a fuzz equivalence corpus and either eliminated or disclosed and ruled on.
business_reason: Keeps the proposal editor's validation routes (D-076-R002) and the future 3D/massing wiring (D-087-R003) safe from a single slow request; the M5-T088 G5 review made this a precondition of any wiring of user geometry.

acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (total bound): a request whose footprint + level outlines exceed the total-positions bound is refused with a typed ProposedMassingError naming the field, before any simplicity check runs (spy proves zero calls); boundary pinned; mutation - removing the bound reddens.

AS-2 (bounded simplicity): the new check's worst case at the maximum allowed input is measured and bounded (numbers recorded before/after); mutation - restoring the all-pairs loop reddens a timing or work-count guard.

AS-3 (decision identity): every existing test in test_scenario_proposal.py and the two API suites passes UNCHANGED; the fuzz corpus shows the same simple/not-simple decision for old vs new on every case (or each disagreement disclosed and ruled on).
AS-4 (fail closed): malformed, non-finite or degenerate outlines keep their typed refusals; shapely exceptions (e.g. GEOSException) can never escape as untyped errors.
AS-5 (scope): zero new dependencies (shapely is admitted); consumers untouched; exactly the allowed paths.
